verdict.rationale: The evidence clearly documents an official Python SDK (pymilvus with MilvusClient), and the same client code runs across Lite, Standalone and Distributed deployments. Nothing in the pack shows official SDKs for the other three languages the story names. missing for 10: evidence of official TypeScript/Node.js, Go and Java SDKs; independent corroboration of SDK quality across languages.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build against official SDKs in the major languages (Python, TypeScript, Go, Java)

citations.quote: This installs `pymilvus`, the Python SDK for Milvus. Use `MilvusClient` to create a client
from pymilvus import MilvusClient client = MilvusClient("milvus_demo.db")

With the same client-side code, you can run GenAI apps with Milvus Lite on a laptop or Jupyter Notebook, or Milvus Standalone on Docker container, or Milvus Distributed on massive scale Kubernetes cluster serving billions of vectors in production.
